lines.zh: 我在半空里飞，脚不着地
lines.en: I fly in midair, feet never touching.

lines.zh: 黑森林的烟在我身后散开
lines.en: Black forest smoke trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀很小，扇得很快
lines.en: My wings are small and beat fast.
I thread between the trunks.

lines.zh: 火把我的影子照在树上
lines.en: Fire throws my shadow onto the trees.
I skim the ground over the lava.
I circle the crimson leaves.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在空中拖出一条线
lines.en: My tail trails a line in the air.
I fly low, but nimbly.

lines.zh: 我从一丛菌菇上面掠过
lines.en: I skim over a clump of fungi.

lines.zh: 我拍翅的声音像一小团火
lines.en: My wingbeat sounds like a small fire.

lines.zh: 我从一个岩浆池上面飞过
lines.en: I fly over a lava pool.
I hover with my arms folded.
The ground below me is smoking.
My skin is a dark red.
I count the falling sparks.
Sparks fall, and I count them.
I tilt my head at a fungus.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在空中慢慢摆
lines.en: My tail sways slowly in the air.

lines.zh: 绯红的树干上有我的影子
lines.en: My shadow is on the crimson trunk.
I warm my hands by the fire.

lines.zh: 一根烧焦的木头断在我下面
lines.en: A charred log breaks beneath me.
I rise to the height of your eyes.

lines.zh: 你从主世界来的，闻得出来
lines.en: You come from the Overworld; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 红色小翅膀扑扇个不停。
lines.en: My small red wings beat without pause.
My wings beat beside your face.
Reach up and I fly higher.
I am smiling as I look at you.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的菌盖底下，是我家。
lines.en: Under a crimson cap is my home.

lines.zh: 尾巴勾住菌柄，倒着看你。
lines.en: My tail hooks a fungus stalk, I peer upside down.

lines.zh: 你在这片林子里不可能久留
lines.en: You cannot stay long in this wood.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，火就跳了一下
lines.en: I reach out and the fire leaps.
The blow rolls me over.
I drop a short way.
A piece of my wing is gone.
Several beats to rise again.
I veer and hit a tree.
I retreat into the smoke, breathing fast.
My wings have lost some lift.
I land on a branch to steady myself.
I shudder and sparks fall.
I press a hand to my chest.

lines.zh: 在绯红菌上盘旋着看你。
lines.en: I hover by the crimson fungus, watching you.

lines.zh: 主世界的味道，很久没有了
lines.en: The smell of the Overworld; it has been long.
I will not eat; I will only smell.
Hold it higher, within my reach.
Give it and I will let you pass.
I land on a branch and wait.

lines.zh: 我落在离你一步的枝上
lines.en: I land one step from you on a branch.

lines.zh: 我不下来，我把手伸下去
lines.en: I stay up and reach a hand down.
Throw it up and I will catch it.

lines.zh: 这东西一进这里就冒烟了
lines.en: It starts smoking the moment it enters here.
We collide and I flip over.
You hit my wings.

lines.zh: 我一下被撞到树干那边
lines.en: I am knocked against the trunk.
Two beats and I steady.
Sparks scatter between us.
I hit you midair and tumble.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过来，我躲开一半
lines.en: Your hand comes through; I half-dodge.
My wings brush your face.
We both strike a branch.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得往下沉了一截
lines.en: You knock me down a stretch.
She hovers higher than I do.
We circle one branch.
Her wing edges are black.

lines.zh: 我们落在同一片叶的两边
lines.en: We land on either side of one leaf.
Her tail touches mine.

lines.zh: 她在我耳边扇了一下翅膀
lines.en: She beats her wings by my ear.

lines.zh: 我们一起往岩浆那边飞
lines.en: We fly toward the lava together.
She rests her head on my shoulder.
We turn a circle in the smoke.
Her hand holds my tail.
I drop down, wings still beating.
I catch it with a hand.
It is hotter than it looks.
I toss it in my hand.
I take it in my teeth and fly back up.
I dive from height.
It is in the ash; I dig it out.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，灰从我手上落
lines.en: I hold it, ash falling off my hand.
I hand it back; too hot.
I carry it in my teeth and fly two circles.
I stop and hover.
My wings beat faster.
Where you stand is within my reach.
I begin to descend.
I stop midair, facing you.
My wings spread wide.
Sparks fall off me.
I drift slowly downward.
You look up and I am above.
I am the fastest thing in this wood.
I smile and the fire brightens.

lines.zh: 我不需要靠近就够得着
lines.en: I need not come close to reach you.

lines.zh: 我的影子覆住你的上半身
lines.en: My shadow covers your upper body.
I count your steps; they are slow.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，指尖有火
lines.en: I raise a hand, fire at the fingertips.
You back to the rock wall; it is hotter there.
I circle your head.

lines.zh: 我一下子贴近，一下子退开
lines.en: I close in, then pull away.
You raise a hand and I climb.
I stay in the patch above your head.
I do not land; landing slows me.
I circle you, lower each pass.
You reach up; I shoot higher.

lines.zh: 我一直不落地，落下就慢
lines.en: I never land; landing slows me.
My wings stir the smoke into rings.

lines.zh: 你转身太慢，我早就换了方向
lines.en: You turn too slowly; I have already moved.
Heat moves your hair.

lines.zh: 我一会儿在这边，一会儿在那边
lines.en: Now here, now there.

lines.zh: 你听见我翅膀的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear my wings?

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你的头顶
lines.en: My tail passes over your head.

lines.zh: 我不进你手够得着的范围
lines.en: I stay out of your reach.
You retreat, and I descend with you.
You stand at the lava's edge.
I fan the fire toward you.

lines.zh: 我在半空悬着，等你抬手。
lines.en: I hover, waiting for you to raise a hand.

lines.zh: 我一直没离开这片树冠
lines.en: I have never left this canopy.
I dive at your face.
My claws catch your shoulder.
My tail whips your brow.
I strike and return to height.
I dive at your face.
My tail lashes your shoulder.
I snatch your collar with a hand.
I strike and climb away.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从你手臂上刮过
lines.en: My claws scrape along your arm.
I come from behind you.
I strike and retreat into the smoke.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的翅膀，我挣开
lines.en: You grab my wing; I wrench free.

lines.zh: 我扇起的火星糊了你一脸
lines.en: The sparks I fan fill your face.
I drive you toward the lava.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就再下来
lines.en: You give half a step, and I come again.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的胸口，自己弹开
lines.en: I hit your chest and bounce off.
My second strike comes from below.

lines.zh: 你挡住上面，我打你的腿
lines.en: You guard high; I take your legs.
I grip your shoulder and pull up.

lines.zh: 我打中了，可我也被撞歪
lines.en: I connect, and am knocked askew.
A burst of sparks scatters first.
I fly out of the smoke.
I hover and take a look first.
Crimson leaves lift as I pass.

lines.zh: 我扇了一下翅膀，烟动了
lines.en: One wingbeat and the smoke moves.

lines.zh: 我落在一根发红的枝上
lines.en: I land on a glowing branch.
A ball of fire lands on a leaf first.

lines.zh: 我从上升的热气里出来
lines.en: I rise out of the hot air.
I hover here, wings never still.
The crimson leaves sway once.
I bring a little smoke with me.

lines.zh: 我落在一根冒烟的枝上
lines.en: I land on a smoking branch.

lines.zh: 火不伤我，可这火太旺了
lines.en: Fire does not hurt me, but this is too much.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀没接住我，我掉下去
lines.en: My wings fail and I drop.

lines.zh: 水把我的翅膀粘住，扇不动
lines.en: Water glues my wings and I cannot beat them.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹得撞上树干
lines.en: The blast throws me into a trunk.
Something scrapes my wing's edge.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住我的翅膀
lines.en: That force presses my wings down.
My flight goes light; my wings have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷光让我整片翅膀都亮了
lines.en: Lightning lights my wings entirely.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，烟也没有了
lines.en: No ground below, and no smoke either.
